Business Rules: Cancel, Refund, Complete Checkout, 3DS Payment & Payout ​

This document describes the business rules and implementation for:

  • Cancel lesson: when cancellation is allowed and when it is blocked.
  • Refund: when a student can request a refund and when admin can approve it.
  • Complete checkout / incomplete checkouts: when a student can complete payment for a pending or T-48 booking.
  • 3DS / failed payment: when a student can complete 3DS or retry a failed payment for a slot.
  • Payout: ensuring no double payout for the same lesson (race-condition safety).

All of these rules were verified and implemented so that the system behaves consistently and safely.

1. Cancel Lesson ​

Rule ​

  • A lesson can only be cancelled if:
    • The slot is not already cancelled, and
    • The slot status is not completed, missed, or refund, and
    • The lesson date has not passed (cancellation only before the booking/slot date).

Implementation ​

LayerLocationWhat was done
Backendserver/src/graphql/resolvers/studentBooking.resolver.js → cancelBookingSlotAfter checking status !== "cancelled", added a check: if slot.status is "completed", "missed", or "refund", throw UserInputError with message "Cannot cancel: lesson is already completed, missed, or refunded." Existing check for slot date in the past is unchanged.
FrontendFrontend/src/pages/private/student-dashboard/bookingDetails.tsxIntroduced cannotCancel: true when isLessonPast or current slot status is completed / missed / refund. Cancel and Reschedule buttons are disabled when cannotCancel. Tooltips explain: "You can't cancel/reschedule: lesson is past or already completed/missed/refunded."

2. Refund (Request & Approve) ​

Rules ​

  • Request refund (student)

    • Only for cancelled lessons.
    • Not allowed if the lesson date has already passed.
    • (Existing: not allowed if already paid out, already refunded, or no payment.)

  • Approve refund (admin)

    • Not allowed if the lesson date has passed.
    • Not allowed if the slot has been marked completed or missed (data integrity).

Implementation ​

LayerLocationWhat was done
Backendserver/src/graphql/resolvers/refundRequest.resolver.js → requestRefundAlready enforced: only cancelled slots, and slotEnd <= new Date() blocks with "Refund cannot be requested for lessons that have already passed." No change.
Backendserver/src/graphql/resolvers/refundRequest.resolver.js → approveRefundRequestNew: Before performing refund, (1) if slot.status is "completed" or "missed", mark request rejected and throw. (2) If slotEnd <= new Date(), mark request rejected and throw. Rejection reasons stored for admin/student.
FrontendFrontend/src/pages/private/student-dashboard/bookingDetails.tsx"Request refund" button disabled when isSlotLessonPast is true. Tooltip: "Refund cannot be requested after the lesson date has passed."

3. Complete Checkout (Incomplete Checkouts) ​

Rules ​

  • Pending booking (never finished checkout)

    • Student must not be able to complete checkout (create session / confirm payment) if the lesson date has passed (e.g. earliest slot start or any slot end in the past).

  • T-48 / booked lesson with incomplete payment (3DS or failed)

    • Student must not be able to complete payment for a slot if:
      • The lesson date has passed, or
      • The instructor has marked the lesson completed or missed.

Implementation ​

LayerLocationWhat was done
BackendstudentBooking.resolver.js → createCheckoutSessionForPendingBookingAfter computing earliestSlotStart, if earliestSlotStart <= now, throw "Cannot complete checkout: lesson date has passed."
BackendstudentBooking.resolver.js → completeBookingFromCheckoutBefore confirming payment, compute slot end times. If any slot’s end time is in the past, throw "Cannot complete checkout: lesson date has passed."
BackendstudentBooking.resolver.js → getT48ClientSecretAfter ensuring slot needs payment (requires_action / payment_failed), added: (1) if slot.status === "completed" || "missed" throw; (2) if slotEnd <= new Date() throw. Messages: "Cannot complete payment: this lesson was marked completed or missed." / "Cannot complete payment: lesson date has passed."
BackendstudentBooking.resolver.js → completeT48SlotPaymentAfter resolving slot from PaymentIntent metadata, added same checks: block if slot is completed/missed or if lesson end time has passed.
FrontendFrontend/src/pages/private/student-dashboard/bookLesson.tsxAlready filters T-48 “complete payment” list by status === "booked" || "confirmed" and slotEnd > now - 1hr, so completed/missed and past slots are not shown. No change.
FrontendFrontend/src/pages/private/student-dashboard/bookingDetails.tsx"Complete payment" (3DS/retry) shown only when canCompletePayment: slot needs payment and !isSlotLessonPast and slot status is not completed/missed. If slot needs payment but cannot complete, an info message is shown instead of the button.

4. 3DS / Failed Payment Completion ​

Same rules as §3 for T-48: no completing 3DS or retry after lesson date has passed or lesson is marked completed/missed. Implemented in:

  • Backend: getT48ClientSecret, completeT48SlotPayment (see table in §3).
  • Frontend: bookingDetails — canCompletePayment and the info message when payment is no longer allowed (see §3).

5. Payout: No Double Payout (Race Condition) ​

Rule ​

  • A lesson that has already been paid out must not be paid out again. Concurrent runs of the payout job must not result in two payouts for the same slot.

Implementation ​

LayerLocationWhat was done
Backendserver/src/models/studentBooking.model.jsExtended payoutStatus enum with "processing" (in addition to not_applicable, pending, completed).
Backendserver/src/jobs/payoutJob.jsFor each slot eligible for payout (payoutStatus === "pending", payoutEligibleAt <= now, etc.): (1) Atomic claim: updateOne with filter slots._id, slots.payoutStatus === "pending", slots.payoutEligibleAt <= now, and set slots.$.payoutStatus = "processing". (2) Only if modifiedCount === 1, call Stripe createManualPayoutForInstructor, then set payoutStatus = "completed" and payoutId. (3) On Stripe failure (except test insufficient-funds), set slot back to "pending" so a later run can retry. This ensures only one process can “claim” a slot and perform the payout.

6. Frontend Helpers (bookingDetails) ​

The following derived values were added or used in bookingDetails.tsx to support the above UI behavior:

VariableMeaning
isLessonPastLast slot of selectedAvailability (by end time) has passed. Used for multi-slot / current booking view.
isSlotLessonPastThe current slot’s lesson end time has passed. Based on currentSlot.date and currentSlot.endTime / startTime.
cannotCancelisLessonPast or current slot status is completed / missed / refund. Disables Cancel and Reschedule.
canCompletePaymentSlot needs payment (requires_action / payment_failed) and !isSlotLessonPast and slot status is not completed or missed. Controls visibility of "Complete payment" and the “no longer payable” message.

currentSlot is either the slot from location state (single-slot view from booked lessons) or the matching slot in selectedAvailability.

7. File Reference ​

FileChanges
server/src/graphql/resolvers/studentBooking.resolver.jsCancel: block completed/missed/refund. Checkout: block if lesson date passed in createCheckoutSessionForPendingBooking and completeBookingFromCheckout. T-48: block in getT48ClientSecret and completeT48SlotPayment if lesson past or completed/missed.
server/src/graphql/resolvers/refundRequest.resolver.jsapproveRefundRequest: reject if slot completed/missed or lesson date passed.
server/src/models/studentBooking.model.jspayoutStatus enum: added "processing".
server/src/jobs/payoutJob.jsAtomic claim (pending → processing) before Stripe payout; reset to pending on non–test failure.
Frontend/src/pages/private/student-dashboard/bookingDetails.tsxisLessonPast, isSlotLessonPast, cannotCancel, canCompletePayment; disable Cancel/Reschedule and Request refund when appropriate; show "Complete payment" only when allowed, else info message; tooltips.
